Results.ReviewText:
Flimsy and not what one would expect from Weber or anything other than a budget grill. The metal is very thin and bends easily. In this case, one leg was bent without any obvious damage to the packaging. The wheels are so thin and unstable that one worries about moving it even on a smooth surface. The side tables are less stable and are more easily bent then on cheaper grills. The drip pan is so light and fits so loosely that it blows out with a breeze. 
Thus far, the burners have worked well.
Results.Title: Disappointed (Not what one would expect)

Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: The new design is well thought out - no more burning your hand reaching in a cabinet to turn off propane valve, much easier to change propane tank with it accessible on the end of the cart, only two wheels which ensures the cart won't roll toward - say e.g. an aluminum window frame and melt it from the heat. Even the plastic hood handle is better - old metal handles got too hot at times especially near the ends. Finally,  the new design to channel the grease is more efficient and the drip pan is more accessible. It may not have the look of the grill with doors but this new design is much easier to use and maintain.
Results.Title: New design weber grill

Results.ReviewText: We bought the grill and used it a few times. Everything was fine at first but then the first burner didn’t seem to be working. I spoke to the store where I bought it and they said I needed to call Weber for help. I spoke to Weber’s customer service where they told me I likely had a defective burner so they sent me a replacement burner kit that I will need to replace myself. They wouldn’t replace the grill that was two weeks old or even have someone fix it. I had to replace a critical piece of the grill myself after spending $600 on a new grill. In hindsight, I would have bought a different brand grill.
Results.Title: Defective burners on new grill

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
